summary: ECMG Electronic Technical Testing Corp. (Shanghai) is a third-party laboratory offering testing and certification services for the semiconductor industry. The company focuses on CE and SEMI certifications, ensuring compliance with industry standards for semiconductor equipment manufacturers.
capabilities: Safety certification services adhering to SEMI standards
Precision testing instruments for rigorous test results

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, ECMG serves the Chinese semiconductor market with accredited testing and certification services.
